production.order: Generate each ON photo first and check the device is clearly on and the hand is on its control; then its OFF edit, which must differ only in the device.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.stairs: The place is the inside of a bright, tidy two-story family house in the daytime. The camera stands downstairs in the front hallway and looks at a straight wooden staircase that rises from the hallway floor to an open upstairs landing with a white wooden banister. The whole staircase, the hallway floor at its foot and the upstairs landing are all clearly visible in the photo, so it is obvious at a glance whether a person is upstairs or downstairs.
shared_prompts.edit: Edit Image 1. Keep the place, the furniture, the light, the colors and the camera position exactly the same; change only what is described below.
shared_prompts.nobody: There are no people anywhere in the photo.
shared_prompts.evening: It is evening: the window shows a dark blue sky.

assets.item: Ana turns on the lamp. / The lamp is on.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans exactly. Create a new photograph: Ana sits on a light-grey sofa in her living room in the evening. Right beside the sofa stands a tall floor lamp with a white fabric shade and a small switch on its stem at hand height. Ana reaches out with one hand and holds the lamp's switch. The lamp is ON: its bulb glows brightly through the shade and warm yellow light fills the room. Ana smiles. The lamp, its glowing shade, the switch and her hand are large and clearly visible.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: Ana turns off the lamp. / The lamp is off.
assets.prompt: Change only the lamp and the light: the lamp is now OFF, its shade is plain white with no glow, and the room is dim, lit only by soft blue evening light from the window. Ana, her smile, her pose and her hand on the lamp's switch stay exactly the same and are still clearly visible.

assets.item: Luis turns on the TV. / The TV is on.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, warm medium-brown skin and navy T-shirt exactly. Create a new photograph from the side, so that both his face and the TV screen are clearly visible: Luis sits in a dark-blue armchair in his living room in the evening and points a black remote control straight at a big flat TV across the room, his arm stretched out toward it. The TV is ON: its big screen shows a bright, colorful picture of green mountains and a blue lake, with no words, numbers or logos.

reference_file.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, warm medium-brown skin, navy T-shirt) sits in a dark-blue armchair in the evening, a remote resting in his hand, and watches a big flat TV showing a blue picture; a floor lamp glows behind it (A1+ 1.8).

assets.item: Luis turns off the TV. / The TV is off.
assets.prompt: Change only the TV: it is now OFF and its whole screen is plain black, with no picture and no light. Luis, his pose and his arm pointing the remote at the TV stay exactly the same.
